title: Influence of a coordinate
statement: Let $\Omega$ be a finite set with probability mass function $\pi$, let $n$ be a natural number, let $f:\Omega^n\to\mathbb R$, and let $i\in\{1,\ldots,n\}$. The influence of coordinate $i$ on $f$ is the product-space inner product of the coordinate difference $f-P_{-i}f$ with itself.
hypotheses_covered: $\pi$ is a probability mass function on $\Omega$
